questions: Should the cumulative explained variance plot include a point for zero components (i.e., start at 0) or only for 1 to n_components?
If n_components is greater than the number of features or samples, should PCA raise an error, use min(n_features, n_samples), or something else?
Should the 'Mean' column be the mean of all component columns per row (as in the reference) or the mean of the original features per row before PCA?
Should the plot's x-axis ticks be integer indices (1,2,...) or continuous (e.g., 0.5, 1.5)?
If data_matrix has fewer rows than n_components, should PCA be applied? (Clarification says samples as rows, but doesn't handle edge.)
Should the function standardize (center/scale) the data before PCA, or use raw covariance?
Should the plot include a title, grid, or other styling beyond the specified labels?
If n_components is not specified (default 2), but data has only 1 feature, should it use 1 component or raise error?
